description: This file defines the BugsViewDetail class, a view component responsible for rendering detailed views of bug records in the SuiteCRM application. It extends the base ViewDetail class and customizes the display method to include portal-related settings.

classes.name: BugsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for displaying detailed information about bug records, with added logic for portal settings.

methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the class by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to include additional logic for checking portal settings and then calls the parent display method.
